note_en: 不仅……还…… means "not only... but also...": 做麻婆豆腐不仅需要嫩豆腐和肉末，还需要豆瓣酱和花椒粉 "you need not only soft tofu and ground meat but also chili bean paste and Sichuan pepper." Both 不仅 and 还 are adverbs, so they sit right before the verb, and the shared verb 需要 is repeated in the second half, where English would just say "but also."
